_meta.method: Crawled and reconciled the Germany directory against current official dojo, network, and DBU sources, including targeted updates for Zen-Zentrum Eisenbuch, Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Solingen, Wuppertal, Bonn, Dresden, Leipzig, and Kassel. Selected entries with sourceable practice locations; deduplicated listings of the same physical place.
_meta.coverageEstimate: ~70-80% of fixed Zen practice places in Germany. zen-guide.de lists ~250 entries (many duplicates / classes-only / dormant); the canonical-place set is roughly 120-160. We capture ~95 with strong sourcing.
knownGaps: Many small Plum Village sanghas listed only by contact name on intersein.de without a stable URL — only sanghas with their own sites included.
Several zen-guide.de entries lack a working external URL (only a /zen/zentren/id/N detail page); these were skipped to keep every entry sourceable.
Kwan Um Deutschland regional groups (Berlin/Hamburg/Köln/Frankfurt) confirmed via Kwan Um Europe directory but per-group sites were not all reachable.
Some Daishin Zen groups (Karlsruhe, Gütersloh, Herford, Volksdorf, Waiblingen) are listed by daishinzen.de only with an email contact and no public site; omitted.
Sanbo Zen Deutschland's regional Zazen-Gruppen beyond Weyarn (under Migaku Sato) are not fully directoried in any single place; only Domicilium / Sanbo Zendo Weyarn included.
Zen-Vereinigung Deutschland member dojos overlap heavily with AZI dojos; we list the AZI-affiliated dojos directly rather than ZVD as an aggregate.

places.name: European Institute of Applied Buddhism (EIAB)
places.notes: Largest Plum Village monastic centre in Europe; founded 2008 by Thich Nhat Hanh; ~40 resident monastics.

places.name: Zen-Kloster Daihizan Fumonji (Zen-Zentrum Eisenbuch)

places.name: Hokuozan Sogenji
places.lineage: Rinzai (One Drop Zen / Shodo Harada Roshi)
places.notes: One Drop Zen identifies Hokuozan as Shodo Harada Roshi’s European monastery, gives Birkenweg 1, and says the smaller zendo is used for a Monday zazen group. The site also describes sesshin practice; confirm arrangements before visiting. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Sanbo Zendo Weyarn (Domicilium)

places.name: Benediktushof Holzkirchen

places.name: Daishin Zen Kloster Buchenberg

places.name: Choka Sangha e.V.

places.name: Dojo Fuku Gen e.V. (Fuku Gen Zen-Dojo)

places.name: Zen Dojo Berlin e.V.

places.name: Akazienzendo Berlin
places.notes: The official site publishes current Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday practice at Tempelhofer Ufer 36 and says the zendo is associated with San Francisco Zen Center.

places.name: Zen-Zentrum Berlin (Kwan Um Zen Schule)
places.notes: Kwan Um Deutschland identifies Chong Hye Sah as the German school headquarters and European main temple. Its current official page gives the address and lists daily morning practice, weekly evening practice, and an introduction.

places.name: Quelle des Mitgefühls
places.notes: Lay practice centre in the Plum Village tradition.

places.name: Wake Up Berlin
places.notes: Young-adult Plum Village sangha.

places.name: Antai-An Zen Dojo Tegel
places.notes: The group’s domain did not provide accessible current item-level evidence in this review. Retained with its Berlin identity while its current schedule, venue, and lineage remain unverified.

places.name: Zen-Dôjô Hôkyô
places.notes: The current official site identifies this dojo as Hôkyô, gives the Große Brunnenstraße 55a venue, lists weekly zazen and October 2026 events, and describes its Sōtō/Zen-Vereinigung lineage. Earlier directory name and address data were outdated.

places.name: Internationales Zen-Institut Deutschland (IZID)

places.notes: The community’s current site says it meets Mondays 19:00–20:30 in Großensee east of Hamburg; it provides the exact address after registration. No lineage claim is made on the current page.

places.name: Zen-Gruppe Hamburg (Kwan Um Zen Schule)
places.notes: The current Kwan Um Germany page identifies the Hamburg group, lists Sunday in-person practice and Wednesday online practice, and gives the local venue at c/o Zen-Dôjô Hôkyô, Große Brunnenstraße 55a.

places.name: Zen Dojo Shobogendo
places.address: Hannover (street address not confirmed on reviewed official pages)
places.notes: The current official site says the dojo was founded in 1982, is led by Zen teacher Dagmar Doko Waskönig, offers zazen multiple times weekly, and has a current introductory course. A street venue was not established on the reviewed pages, so the listing remains city-level.

places.name: Zendo Köln e.V.

places.name: Daishin Zen Köln

places.name: Zen-Gruppe Köln (Kwan Um Zen Schule)

places.notes: Kwan Um Germany lists the Cologne group and identifies its practice venue at Aikido Centrum Köln, Neusser Straße 478. The listing is based on the school’s group directory; no local schedule is asserted.

places.name: Stadtraum Köln (Plum Village Sangha)
places.notes: Werner Heidenreich (Dharma Teacher).

places.name: Wolken und Wasser Rinzai Zen Dojo

The official page confirms the Rinzai dojo identity; check its current schedule before visiting. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Daishin Zen Düsseldorf (Zendo Düsseldorf)
places.address: ISS Facility Services Holding GmbH, Theodorstraße 178, 40472 Düsseldorf, Germany
places.notes: The current local page lists Tuesday 18:00–20:00 practice and monthly introductions at Theodorstraße 178. The group describes its practice as Daishin Zen, a modern Rinzai path.

places.name: BuddhaWeg-Sangha – Zen-Zentrum Solingen e.V.

places.name: Zendo Wuppertal e.V.
places.notes: The official site publishes Thursday practice and Sunday practice by arrangement, monthly introductions, and the Wittensteinstraße 91 venue. Its association page identifies its Sōtō lineage and AZI/ABZE memberships.

places.name: Zen-Dojo Dorsten
places.notes: Antaiji identifies Thomas Shinryû Hortlik as the person behind a Soto Zen site and as a Zen monk ordained at Antaiji; older Zen directory data associates him with a Dorsten group. No current official Dorsten schedule or venue was verified. Retained provisionally at city level; current activity and address need confirmation. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Eido-Ji Temple
places.notes: DBU minutes identify the temple; a 2026 third-party retreat listing gives a Goch venue, but current local practice details and a direct site could not be verified.

places.name: Zen Institut Münster e.V.
places.notes: The organization’s current official site gives the Aegidiistraße 61/62 zendo and weekly public zazen: Tuesday evening, Thursday morning, Friday afternoon, and Sunday morning, with an introduction arranged before first attendance. Its practice is described as Soto-inspired Zen with historical multiple influences; no singular institutional lineage is asserted. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Kanjizai-Dojo / Zendo Aachen e.V.
places.notes: Official dojo page lists Tuesday 20:00–21:30, Thursday 19:00–20:30, and Sunday 09:00–10:15 zazen; affiliated with AZI and ABZE, led by Eveline Pascual, student of Roland Yuno Rech.

places.name: Bambushain Sangha – Zhulinci Tempel
places.address: Wushan Academy, Hanbrucher Straße 40, 52064 Aachen, Germany
places.notes: ZCLA’s current affiliates page lists Bambushain Zen Center, its coordinator, Aachen venue, and Monday and Friday practice. Confirm the schedule locally; no succession claim after founder Paul Shoju Schwerdt is made here.

places.name: Zen Dojo Bonn e.V. – San Bo Dojo
places.notes: The dojo’s official contact page confirms Heerstraße 167 and weekly zazen, including Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday in-person sessions. Its practice page identifies the teacher as ordained by Roland Yuno Rech.

places.name: White Light Zendo (Zaltho-Sangha e.V.)

places.name: Zen-Dojo Ho Rin Ji

A 2025 event notice gives Schroten 4, 66121 Saarbrücken. This venue replaces an older directory address; confirm the current public timetable before visiting. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Daishin Zen Saarbrücken (Zendo Saar)
places.notes: Listed in the Daishin Zen local group network; current schedule and venue details were not verified.

places.name: Europäisches Zentrum für Meditation und Begegnung Neumühle

places.name: Zen Dojo Kaiserslautern

places.name: Zen-Dojo Mannheim

It identifies the group’s connection to Zen-Master Olivier Reigen Wang-Genh and the Ryumon Ji monastery. First attendance requires an introduction and registration. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Pagode Phat Hue

places.name: Zen-Do-Kai e.V. München
places.notes: The organization’s listed domain could not be independently verified as a current official page in this review. Older directory material names a Munich Soto group but does not establish its present venue or schedule. Retained provisionally at city level; current activity and lineage need confirmation. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: OneDropZendo München

Older directory evidence gives a Munich identity; current local venue and schedule are unverified. Retained provisionally pending direct confirmation.

places.name: Ryû-Un-Zendô
places.notes: The official 2026 calendar lists Zazentage at Buddhistisches Zentrum Scheibbs, Austria, but does not establish a current Munich meeting place or schedule. The Munich pin and local activity remain unverified; the Austria events do not establish closure.

places.name: Bodhidharma Tempel München
places.notes: The official site identifies a Taego Zen temple at Heßstraße 98 with weekly activities, but requires advance contact and does not publish a fixed public timetable. Precise generational claims are not repeated.

places.name: Hannya-Kai Zen-Gemeinschaft e.V.

places.name: Soto Zen in Königsdorf
places.notes: The Association Zen Internationale directory currently lists a Königsdorf practice group. No current meeting address or timetable was established from that directory; the organization’s own site could not be verified in this review. Retained provisionally with city-level location only; confirm details with the group. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Zen Dojo Dô-Now e.V.
places.notes: The available Zen Guide entry reports a Regensburg group, a former address at Weingasse 4, and recurring Tuesday/Wednesday meditation, but it is an editable third-party directory and gives no current update. No current official group site or venue was verified. Retained provisionally at city level; present activity, address, timetable, and lineage need direct confirmation. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Zen in Augsburg
places.notes: The group’s official site describes an open Rinzai practice group, names teacher Hogen, and lists weekly Sunday and Wednesday zazen with kinhin at Ortlerstraße 71. The site also gives periodic intensive practice days. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: TAO Bamberg

The evidence supports the venue and a Zen-related instructor, but does not establish a current recurring public Zen schedule or the prior Rinzai affiliation. Confirm whether Zen practice is currently offered. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Daishin Zen Zendo Stuttgart-Waiblingen

places.name: Hi Gi Zen Dojo Karlsruhe

places.name: Hei Jô Zen Dojo e.V.

places.name: HO UN DO Zen-Dojo Freiburg

The page gives Hauptstraße 1. Retreat and heritage context are distinguished from the current recurring schedule. Checked 2026-10-08.

places.name: Wolkentor Zen-Tempel
